items.title: Andrew Bailey Interview, 1959-09-30
items.q: The interviewee mentions 'Chris Keller' only in the context of describing dances ('rock and roll', 'lindy hop') that people liked. There is no evidence of a personal, professional, or musical relationship between Andrew Bailey and Chris Keller.
